name: LightBurn Isolation Artwork
description: Export laser-ready PCB isolation artwork for LightBurn
description_full: Plots copper layers from the open board and converts them into isolation-moat artwork for a UV galvo laser, driven from LightBurn. Unions KiCad's stroked traces into fillable outlines, grows the copper by a configurable moat offset, and subtracts it from a board-sized frame so only the isolation regions burn. Can also emit positive copper artwork for a spray-and-etch workflow. Drills, edge cuts and registration holes are colour-separated onto their own LightBurn layers, all sharing the drill/place origin.
